stop_sales_ended_check.name: stop_sales_ended_check
stop_sales_ended_check.value: ("catalog"."stop_sales"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("catalog"."stop_sales"."ended_by_id" IS NULL) AND ("catalog"."stop_sales"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("catalog"."stop_sales"."ended_by_type" IS NULL)

early_access_requests_subject_check.name: early_access_requests_subject_check
early_access_requests_subject_check.value: user_id IS NOT NULL OR invited_email IS NOT NULL

lots_lot_number_check.name: lots_lot_number_check
lots_lot_number_check.value: ("inventory"."lots"."tracking" = 'lot') = ("inventory"."lots"."lot_number" IS NOT NULL) AND ("inventory"."lots"."lot_number" IS NULL OR char_length("inventory"."lots"."lot_number") BETWEEN 1 AND 40)

lots_quarantine_check.name: lots_quarantine_check
lots_quarantine_check.value: ("inventory"."lots"."quarantined_at" IS NULL) = ("inventory"."lots"."quarantine_reason" IS NULL) AND ("inventory"."lots"."quarantined_at" IS NULL) = ("inventory"."lots"."quarantined_by_id" IS NULL) AND ("inventory"."lots"."quarantined_at" IS NULL) = ("inventory"."lots"."quarantined_by_type" IS NULL)

recalls_ended_check.name: recalls_ended_check
recalls_ended_check.value: ("inventory"."recalls"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("inventory"."recalls"."ended_by_id" IS NULL) AND ("inventory"."recalls"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("inventory"."recalls"."ended_by_type" IS NULL)

reconciliations_ended_check.name: reconciliations_ended_check
reconciliations_ended_check.value: ("inventory"."reconciliations"."status" = 'open') = ("inventory"."reconciliations"."ended_at" IS NULL) AND ("inventory"."reconciliations"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("inventory"."reconciliations"."ended_by_id" IS NULL) AND ("inventory"."reconciliations"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("inventory"."reconciliations"."ended_by_type" IS NULL)

reservations_release_reason_check.name: reservations_release_reason_check
reservations_release_reason_check.value:
("inventory"."reservations"."status" = 'released') = ("inventory"."reservations"."release_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("inventory"."reservations"."release_reason" IS NULL OR release_reason IN ('checkout_cancelled', 'order_cancelled', 'refunded', 'staff_correction'))

reservations_expires_at_check.name: reservations_expires_at_check
reservations_expires_at_check.value: ("inventory"."reservations"."kind" = 'hold' AND "inventory"."reservations"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("inventory"."reservations"."kind" = 'order' AND "inventory"."reservations"."expires_at" IS NULL)

delivery_settings_free_from_check.name: delivery_settings_free_from_check
delivery_settings_free_from_check.value: free_from_cents IS NULL OR (free_from_cents >= 0 AND free_from_cents <= 100000)

refunds_note_check.name: refunds_note_check
refunds_note_check.value: "orders"."refunds"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("orders"."refunds"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

dsr_requests_extension_check.name: dsr_requests_extension_check
dsr_requests_extension_check.value: ("privacy"."dsr_requests"."original_due_at" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extended_at" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_months" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_reason" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_notice_at" IS NULL) OR ("privacy"."dsr_requests"."original_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_months" IN (1, 2) AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."due_at" > "privacy"."dsr_requests"."original_due_at")
